title: Google Integrates Nano Banana2 into Google Earth to Support Online AI-Generated Geospatial Images
excerpt: Google announced that the latest Nano Banana2 AI image generation model has been officially integrated into Google Earth, making the AI image generation feature
content_html:
Google announced that the latest Nano Banana2 AI image generation model has been officially integrated into Google Earth, making the AI image generation feature available to all users of the Google Earth web version worldwide. This upgrade combines generative AI with the satellite imagery, aerial photography, and 3D terrain data accumulated by Google Earth, further enhancing the visualization capabilities of geographic content.

Users simply need to locate any place on the Google Earth web version, click "Create Image," and enter a scene description. Nano Banana2 will then generate high-precision custom images based on the geographical data of the current location, providing a more rich visual expression for real-world scenes.

Google stated that this feature can cover multiple scenarios such as education, professional applications, and personal creation. For example, educators can use AI to restore historical sites, reconstructing the ruins of Pompeii in ancient Rome into their former cityscapes; in professional fields, it can be used to create visualized geographic information charts, real estate planning schemes, and pre-construction effect displays for engineering projects; ordinary users can also use AI to generate creative visual content for familiar locations, enhancing the exploration experience.

As Nano Banana2 is now available on Google Earth, generative AI is further integrating into digital maps and spatial computing platforms, expanding from traditional geographic browsing to content creation and scenario simulation, offering richer visualization applications for industries such as education, urban planning, and architectural design.

content_html_zh:
谷歌宣布，最新的 Nano Banana2 AI 图像生成模型已正式集成到 Google Earth 中，让全球 Google Earth 网页版的所有用户都可以使用 AI 图像生成功能。 此次升级将生成式AI与Google Earth积累的卫星图像、航拍和3D地形数据相结合，进一步增强了地理内容的可视化能力。

用户只需在谷歌地球网络版上找到任意地点，点击“创建图像”，然后输入场景描述即可。 Nano Banana2随后将根据当前位置的地理数据生成高精度的自定义图像，为现实世界场景提供更丰富的视觉表达。

谷歌表示，该功能可以覆盖教育、专业应用、个人创作等多个场景。 例如，教育工作者可以利用人工智能修复历史遗迹，将古罗马庞贝城的废墟重建成昔日的城市景观；在专业领域，可用于创建可视化地理信息图表、房地产规划方案、工程项目施工前效果展示等；普通用户还可以利用人工智能为熟悉的地点生成创意视觉内容，增强探索体验。

随着Nano Banana2登陆Google Earth，生成式AI进一步融入数字地图和空间计算平台，从传统的地理浏览扩展到内容创作和场景模拟，为教育、城市规划、建筑设计等行业提供更丰富的可视化应用。
